taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-03 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 177.8 | 13.27 | 13.27
2 | 265.8 | 3.40 | 16.67
3 | 1064.5 | 8.81 | 25.48
4 | 2584.7 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as HA-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-03
Curve type: HA
Aquifer depth: 13.27 m – 16.67 m
Recommendation: Target the moderate-resistivity zone between 13.27 m and 16.67 m (Layer 2) as the primary aquifer horizon, casing off the overlying weathered layer; anticipate hard, high-resistivity basement rock below 16.67 m, so plan to terminate or case off drilling once resistive bedrock is encountered to avoid unproductive deepening.
